rows.Kwic: 唾。較量將來，有甚底止？豈不聞：石頭大師云：『執事元是迷，契理亦非悟。門門一切境，回互不回互。回而更相涉，不爾依位住。』諸昆仲！此是我洞上法幢所由立也
頓現無心之良久，明其先知有因而不知有，後不知有因而知有，凡情聖見共相回互。豈如峰之頌茫茫忽忽，認影迷頭？嗟哉！休將閒學解

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yingning Jing (攖寧靜禪師語錄), in Yingning Jing's continued reply to Sanfeng Cang and Yunmen Zhan concerning the Caodong sixteen questions. Yingning Jing explains the earlier and later pauses and says that ordinary feelings and holy views mutually interchange. The section addressee Yunmen Zhan is not Yunmen Wenyan and is not the speaker of this prose.

rows.Kwic: 所云直心是道場，無虛假故。

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yingning Jing (攖寧靜禪師語錄), in Yingning Jing's continued reply. The formula introduced by '所云' quotes Vimalakirti's answer to the youth Light Adornment: Vimalakirti is the exact quoted speaker who says that straight mind is the site of awakening because it has no falseness. An independent corpus witness preserves the full named dialogue; Yunmen Wenyan is neither the source nor the section's Yunmen addressee.
